NATIONAL WATER SUPPLY AND DRAINAGE BOARD ACT, No. 02 OF 1974
Order under Section 92

BY virtue of the powers vested in me, under Section 92 of the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act, No.02 of1974, I, Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, do hereby approve the acquisition of the immovableproperty, shown in the following schedule as it is required by the National Water Supply and Drainage Board, for theresettlement of the affected residents of the Divisional Secretary Division of Attanagalle due to construction of theBasnagoda Reservoir under the Gampaha, Attanagalle and Minuwangoda Joint Water Supply Scheme.
RAUFF HAKEEM,Minister of City Planning and
Water Supply.Ministry of City Planning and Water Supply,No. 35, ‘Lakdiya Medura’,New Parliament Road,Pelawatta, Battaramulla,11th May 2016.5/2/2/1212
SCHEDULE

An allotment of land called Sapugasovita in the Valikadamulla village in the Grama Niladhari Division of No.363 Walikadamulla in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Attanagalle in the Gampaha District and in extent of about20 acres of land bounded as follows :—
North by:Remaining portion of the same land;East by:Remaining portion of the same land;South by:Attanagalle - Galapitamada Road ;West by:Remaining portion of the same land.
Name and address of the claimant :Kurunegala Plantation Corporation Ltd,P. O. Box 25, No. 80,Dambulla Road,Kurunegala.
